title: NewLanta CAP - New Beamer
htmlContent:
Talented artist "NewLanta CAP" has paved way for himself in the music industry. He recently dropped off the new hit “New Beamer” featuring 1kElway and has earned the respect of many media outlets. “New Beamer” has been gaining steam by the day, NewLanta CAP is back and fiercer with his music.

Besides the visuals and the concept, “New Beamer” is a melodic masterpiece. The song stands out with its trippy, almost skit-like effects with a piece of background music that bumps hard. “New Beamer” is a fresh wave of energetic rhythm and electrifying beats that spurs people to groove any time of the day.
